scenario.title: Autonomous Agent: Deployment Decision
scenario.description: Selects optimal multi-region failover topology under 150ms cross-Atlantic latency.

standard.text: Recommendation: Google Cloud Spanner with witness-only replicas in Europe. TrueTime GPS atomic clocks eliminate wide 2PC overhead, guaranteeing strict serializability with sub-50ms local reads and deterministic failover across regions.

scenario.title: Multi-Turn Chat: Async Deadlock Diagnosis
scenario.description: Diagnoses production FastAPI asyncio deadlock under concurrent database pool exhaustion.

standard.text: Root cause: Threadpool starvation from run_in_executor + unawaited event loop scheduling. Fix: Migrate to asyncpg native async protocol, isolate CPU tasks to ProcessPoolExecutor, never call loop.run_until_complete inside active coroutines.

scenario.title: Dense Retrieval: Architecture Spec Lookup
scenario.description: Retrieves Apple Silicon Metal threadgroup barrier semantics from hardware specification.

standard.text: threadgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup) synchronizes all 32 SIMD lanes. Device memory requires memory_order_seq_cst atomics across AMX matrix co-processors. L1 cache invalidation is automatic via unified SLC write-back upon threadgroup completion.

scenario.title: Multi-Hop Logic: Base-3 Shannon Entropy Proof
scenario.description: Derives the Shannon entropy bound and compression gap for ternary base-3 packing.

standard.text: Proof: 3^5=243<=256=2^8, so 5 ternary weights pack into 1 byte = 1.600 bits/weight. Shannon entropy of uniform ternary source: log2(3)=1.58496 bits. Overhead: 1.600-1.58496=0.01504 bits/w. Packing efficiency: 99.06% of theoretical limit.

scenario.title: Security Logic: Kernel Use-After-Free Analysis
scenario.description: Traces race condition in concurrent slab allocator to identify exploit class.

standard.text: Vulnerability: Non-atomic check-then-set between free_count decrement and chunk unlinking. Concurrent thread B races thread A's freelist traversal without page lock, causing pointer aliasing. Result: Double Free in freelist head -> arbitrary heap metadata corruption -> write-what-where RCE.

scenario.title: Chat: GPU Memory Bandwidth Optimization
scenario.description: Advises on saturating Apple Silicon unified memory bandwidth for 27B single-batch inference.

standard.text: Strategy: 1) Scheme S2 Base-3 compression (1.60 b/w) eliminates 20% DRAM weight traffic. 2) Fuse GEMV + activation transforms into single Metal threadgroup pass. 3) 4-bit grouped residual KV cache keeps full context in L2/SLC, eliminating DRAM KV reads.

scenario.title: Quantum Logic: Toffoli Gate Circuit Synthesis
scenario.description: Synthesizes minimal Clifford+T decomposition for fault-tolerant Toffoli execution.

standard.text: Toffoli decomposition: T-count=7, T-depth=4 (ancilla-free). With 1 clean ancilla: T-depth reduces to 1 via measurement-assisted uncomputation (Jones 2013). T gates require magic state distillation on surface codes — T-depth dominates fault-tolerance cost.

scenario.title: Architecture Decision: Streaming Broker Selection
scenario.description: Selects optimal event streaming backbone for 2M events/sec global fintech with ordered dedup.

standard.text: Decision: Apache Pulsar. Stateless broker compute decoupled from BookKeeper storage enables independent scaling without partition rebalancing at 2M evt/s. First-class multi-tenancy (tenant/namespace isolation) and geo-replication outperform Kafka operationally. NATS JetStream eliminated due to insufficient historical segment retention guarantees.
